description: Tool built for developers — code, APIs, CLIs, and technical workflows. Industry brain defines the development domain. This core defines how developer-first products are experienced.

relationships: User belongs to a Team and owns or contributes to Projects
Repository contains Files and has Builds
Build belongs to Repository, has a Status and Logs
Deployment belongs to Build, targets an Environment
APIKey belongs to User or Project — grants API access
Log belongs to Build or Deployment
Environment belongs to Project — production, staging, development
Integration connects Project to an external service
Usage tracks API calls, compute, or storage per Project
Webhook belongs to Project, fires on events
Documentation is associated with Project or API

mvp.description: Core developer tool — project setup, API access, logs, basic deployment.
primary_flows: Sign up → create project → get API key → integrate → view usage
Deploy project → monitor build → view logs → check deployment status
Browse documentation → copy code snippet → integrate in own project

interaction_patterns: Build status badge — building spinner, success green, failed red
Log stream — monospace font, auto-scroll, new lines append at bottom
Error lines in logs — red background highlight
API key masked — dots until reveal button tapped — copy after reveal
Code examples — language tabs (JS, Python, curl) — switch without reload
Copy code button — top right of every code block — changes to tick on copy
Deploy button — triggers build — shows building state immediately
Empty state — terminal-style message with command to get started

Set up webhook → external service receives events → builds triggered automatically
Connect integration → CI/CD pipeline linked → push to repo → auto-deploy
Invite team → assign roles → team member deploys → owner sees activity
secondary_flows: Set up environment variables per environment

interaction_patterns: All MVP interaction patterns
Build step timeline — each step expands to show its logs
Environment tag on builds — production red, staging amber, dev blue
Promote deployment button — confirm modal with diff summary
Webhook delivery — shows request and response body on expand
Environment variable — add from .env file — paste or upload
Domain SSL badge — valid green with expiry date, expired red
Alert fired — red banner on monitoring page, notification sent
Roll back button — previous deployment card — confirm modal

scale.description: Enterprise developer platform with SSO, audit logs, custom infra, multi-region, compliance, and white-label.
primary_flows: Enterprise admin configures SSO → team logs in with company credentials → roles auto-assigned
Set up multi-region deployment → select regions → traffic routing configured → monitor per region
Compliance officer exports audit log → reviews all deployments and API usage → satisfies SOC2 audit
Platform operator creates workspace → enterprise customer onboards → isolated environment
Fine-grained permission policy — admin creates policy → assigns to team → enforced on all actions
secondary_flows: Cost allocation by team or project
